scope.notes: Seven functional requirements spanning request translation, response translation, streaming synthesis, error shaping, token counting, endpoint wiring and a config fix. Three new translator classes plus schema enums. Large but bounded.

integration.notes: Introduces a second inbound protocol into a codebase that currently has exactly one. Touches the proxy path, the SSE emitter, AppJsonContext, Program.cs, providers.example.json and the dashboard. Streaming integration is the highest-risk surface in the entire codebase.

infrastructure.notes: No new external services. Reference translator in-repo provides patterns. Anthropic API contract is the dependency, and it is documented.

knowledge.notes: Anthropic event model does not map one-to-one onto OpenAI deltas. The in-repo reference implements exactly this translation, but extracting the pattern correctly into AOT-safe C# is non-trivial. Team has not shipped a translator before.

risk.notes: Two pre-existing SSE defects block this story (single-newline framing, post-start response mutation). Streaming translation cannot be built on a path that throws at the end of every successful stream. Estimate is the least reliable in Epic 8.

flags: STREAMING-RISK: spike the streaming path before committing the 40h estimate
SSE-DEFECTS: single-newline framing and post-start response mutation must be fixed as prerequisites
AOT-UNMEASURED: Anthropic schema registration cost versus the 50MB idle ceiling is unmeasured
CLIENT-VALIDATION: verify against a real Anthropic-format client, not just unit tests
estimatedEffort: 40 hours baseline; spike recommended before commitment
